short_description: Guided sunset bike ride from San Francisco piers across the Golden Gate Bridge with coastal views and historic stops.
description: Enjoy a professionally guided sunset bike tour that follows San Francisco’s scenic coastline from the piers through Crissy Field and past Fort Point to the Golden Gate Bridge. Ride on the west/ocean side of the bridge, open to cyclists after 3pm, then continue across and explore lesser-known roads, historic monuments and graveyards that reveal the city’s past. The tour offers photo opportunities, coastal breezes and a relaxed pace suited to families and beginners while highlighting local history and iconic views.

what_is_included_items.value: Coastal route along the piers, Crissy Field and Fort Point
Passage across the Golden Gate Bridge (west/ocean side when available)
Historic stops after crossing the bridge
Bike lock, Helmet, Front handlebar bag

what_is_not_included_items.value: Optional gratuities for the tour guide

itinerary:
Guided Bike Tour with Bay City Bike Rentals and Tours (Up to 3 hours):

* Meet your guide at 📍 2661 Taylor Street TOUR CENTER in Fisherman’s Wharf
* Bike fitting and safety orientation
* Fisherman’s Wharf waterfront
* Pass through the Marina District
* Ride along Crissy Field
* Ride aross the Golden Gate Bridge on the west/ocean side (photo stop)
* Visit Presidio park 
* Return 📍 2661 Taylor Street
highlights:
* Sunset views of the Golden Gate Bridge and San Francisco coastline
* Photo opportunities at iconic piers, Crissy Field and Fort Point
* Ride the west/ocean side of the bridge when open to cyclists
* Historic monuments and graveyards showcasing the city’s past
check_in_details: Arrive 30 minutes before the tour start time at 2661 Taylor Street tour center in Fisherman's Wharf.
special_requirements:
All riders are required to sign a liability waiver prior to riding. Guests under 18 must have a parent or legal guardian present to sign on their behalf and accompany them at check-in.

If you book online, you’ll receive an electronic waiver to complete in advance. Walk-in guests will complete the waiver during check-in before the rental begins.
disclaimers: West/ocean side of the Golden Gate Bridge opens to cyclists at 3pm; access to that side is subject to that schedule.

faq_items.question: What time does the bike tour leave?
faq_items.answer: The tour departs at available time, please call us at (415) 346-2453. We ask that all guests arrive at least 30 minutes early to complete paperwork and be fitted for their bikes. The tour is approximately 8 miles and lasts up to 3 hours. The tour departs from our Fisherman’s Wharf Tour Center, located at 2661 Taylor Street.

faq_items.question: Is there a bike path across the Golden Gate Bridge?
faq_items.answer: Yes. The Golden Gate Bridge has dedicated bike access, with cyclists sharing one side of the bridge depending on the day and time. The path is clearly marked and well-maintained. Our Golden Gate Bridge tours provide up-to-date guidance on which side to ride and ensure a safe, stress-free crossing.

faq_items.question: What's included with a Bay City Bike guided bike tour of San Francisco?
faq_items.answer: In addition to fabulous routes led by local guides, we provide your bike rental, helmet, a front camera bag, bells, maps and map holders, water bottle holders, and locks. We also have kid equipment options.

faq_items.question: Is Bay City Bike open daily?
faq_items.answer: We are open 365 days a year, rain or shine. We suggest booking your tour ahead of time though, as spots can fill up quick. We also offer a 20% discount if you book online!
